scope: Developer-authored synthetic protocol and actual DeliberativeEvidenceReader orchestration tests; no benchmark answers used as test input and no inference of real model accuracy.

findings.reproduced: Old implementation rebound identical text across namespace/version/observation clock. Initial independent rerun had three failing tests.
findings.resolution: Current _can_rebase uses full AdmittedSnapshot semantic identity after permitting only a containing current content window. Rebind and accept regressions now cover namespace/version/lifecycle/source-ref/statement role/clock/message identity changes.

findings.reproduced: Old implementation allowed ANSWER 37 to become ANSWER 999 using a support defect without a source label. Fourth initial test failed.
findings.resolution: Current parse_review permits a no-label support defect only for final ABSTAIN. Actual reader rejects twice-invalid revisions without falling back to the draft.

actual_reader_behaviors: All three phases required, including for an abstaining draft
Search and active-read admit only their returned evidence and annotate initial/search/read before model visibility
Question contract and bounded claim records carried as untrusted context
Exact draft citation snapshots passed to review validator in citation order, with current labels allowed to change
accept cannot silently rewrite answer qualifiers or drop an original cited premise
One shared repair slot across all phases; exhausted review never falls back to draft
Initial provenance fault is ERROR with zero model calls
New factory profile uses normal plan8192, reasoning synthesis/review16384, admitted-v1 and explicit source annotation

failures_preserved: argument-independent-before-v2.txt: four product red tests before source fixes
argument-independent-after-v2.txt: 28 passed/1 failed; test fixture used old index1 after review pins reordered source m1 to index0, corrected to current index0
First formatting invocation used system Python without ruff; subsequent checks use repository .venv interpreter. No provider call.
limits: Syntax-valid labels, claims, defect reasons and actions cannot mechanically prove semantic entailment. A model can still cite a real unrelated passage or propose an unsupported interpretation; real frozen evaluation remains necessary.
Four-argument direct validate_review calls retain conclusion/citation checks; the real reader now supplies the fifth snapshot argument for semantic identity checks.
Synthetic clients supply scripted decisions; these tests prove host boundaries/orchestration and detect the reproduced holes, not reasoning accuracy or a benchmark gain.
When an old premise is unavailable, bounded model-written claim text remains untrusted and is marked unavailable; no old source passage is reintroduced as a source.
